zh.headline: 英伟达换帅，黄仁勋辞职引发连锁反应
headline_alt: 黄仁勋离任震动 AI 创投圈
创始人时代的终结与算力资本重估
zh.observation: 黄仁勋辞职是今天所有新闻的引力中心，但真正值得警惕的不是人事，而是 WSJ 披露的财务担保模式——英伟达用表外承诺撑起了下游云厂商和 OpenAI 的采购能力，这种杠杆一旦收缩，冲击会沿着融资链条传导到每一家 AI 初创。与之对照，Anthropic IPO 超额认购 6 倍、LangChain 估值 30 亿，说明资本并未离场，而是在重新挑选确定性更高的标的。技术层面，Gemini 4 Hydrogen 的低价长上下文、TPU Sync 的 KV 传输优化、Perplexity 的决策小模型，共同指向同一个方向：Agent 的竞争正从“能不能做”转向“每 token 多便宜”。而 ChatGPT Wallet 与 Claude for Manufacturing 则表明，Agent 的商业闭环已经开始触碰钱和工厂，这两处的合规与审批设计会比模型能力更早成为瓶颈。

items.title: 黄仁勋辞任英伟达 CEO，市值蒸发超 3 万亿
items.desc: 英伟达 33 年来首次换帅，黄仁勋因与一名疑似中国间谍的婚外情辞职，临时 CEO 由前 CFO Colette Kress 接任。
items.value: AI 算力最重要的供应方进入不确定期，所有依赖 GPU 的团队需重估供应链与融资环境。

items.title: 黄仁勋离任或与英伟达高风险商业操作有关
items.desc: WSJ 报道称，英伟达曾为云厂商的芯片采购提供数十亿美元财务担保（含与 OpenAI 的 2500 亿美元计划），Kress 试图控制风险但遭黄仁勋反对。
items.value: 揭示英伟达表外风险敞口，解释辞职背后可能不只是个人生活问题。

items.title: 创投圈预警：黄仁勋离任将冲击 AI 创业融资
items.desc: VC 与创始人表示，英伟达此前向 AI 初创投入数百亿美元，失去黄仁勋后，融资额度与估值都将收缩。
items.value: AI 初创需提前规划现金流，依赖英伟达系资本的公司风险最高。

items.title: 研究称六家中国头部模型使用了受出口管制的 Blackwell 芯片
items.desc: 前 OpenAI 研究员 Will DePue 通过读取模型权重中的芯片指纹，称 DeepSeek、Moonshot、MiniMax、蚂蚁集团等训练所用硬件成本超 5 亿美元。
items.value: 出口管制执行可能收紧，中国团队的算力获取路径面临更严审查。

items.title: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Wallet，Agent 可代用户下单支付
items.desc: 先向美国 Pro 订阅用户限量开放，用户绑定一次卡片，每次购买需 Face ID 或指纹确认，卡号以支付令牌隐藏。
items.value: Agent 商业闭环首次打通支付环节，电商与支付产品的接入方式将被重写。

items.title: Anthropic IPO 超额认购 6 倍，或成史上最大 IPO
items.desc: 同时，因美国出口管制（ITAR），承销银行拒绝中国大陆与香港投资者的认购订单。
items.value: AI 头部公司资本化加速，但地缘政治正直接切割投资准入。

items.title: OpenAI 解散机器人团队，通用模型已能直接驱动机器人
items.desc: 机器人团队被撤，公司转向由通用模型直接控制硬件。
items.value: 机器人创业公司的差异化空间被压缩，通用模型厂商成为上游竞争者。

items.title: Anthropic 发布 Claude for Manufacturing
items.desc: 插件直连 Autodesk Fusion、Oracle NetSuite、Infor，17 项技能可起草报价、比价、延迟时下补单，均需人工审批；另有 Model Hardware Standard 在研。
items.value: Agent 进入工业软件栈的落地样板，制造业集成商可参考其审批式设计。

items.title: LangChain 估值达 30 亿美元
items.desc: 其模型与平台无关的 Agent 管理工具 LangSmith 已拥有 7000 家客户。
items.value: Agent 可观测与编排层被资本确认为独立赛道。

items.title: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen
items.desc: 面向 Agent 场景的高速模型，100 万 token 窗口、4 档思考深度，定价 $1.50/$7.50，Artificial Analysis 得分 51，Terminal-Bench 4.1 达 57%，速度是 Gemini 3.8 Flash 的 2.5 倍，已接入 Search 与 Gemini App。
items.value: 低成本长上下文 Agent 模型再添强选项，需注意 Gemini 4 系列 12 月起涨价。

items.title: Meta Muse 可代用户拨打美国商家电话
items.desc: 付费订阅可用，AI 负责人 Alexandr Wang 称 Muse 已有超 1000 万用户；但不少商家一识别出 AI 就挂断。
items.value: 语音 Agent 落地遇真实阻力，商家侧 AI 识别与拦截将成新需求。

items.title: OpenAI 以 Daybreak 品牌进军网络安全市场
items.desc: 推出两款安全产品。
items.value: 安全厂商需评估与基础模型厂商的直接竞争关系。

items.title: EgoX：跨具身自我中心操作学习框架
items.desc: 通过语义对齐的观测与动作模态组织人类、真机、仿真三类异构演示，预训练模块化跨具身 Transformer。
items.value: 为机器人策略提供统一利用多源数据的路径，降低对单一真机数据的依赖。

items.title: PixVid：把潜空间视频扩散模型提升到像素空间
items.desc: 绕开 VAE 时空压缩带来的分辨率、逐帧条件与交互限制。
items.value: 高分辨率、可交互视频生成的关键一步，直接影响视频模型架构选型。

items.title: 零或 T 思考：混合决策模型学习何时推理
items.desc: 单一模型要么在一次前向中直接作答（生成 0 token），要么在值得时进行完整自回归推理。
items.value: 为决策类模型提供推理成本自适应方案，对 Agent 延迟与成本优化有直接价值。

items.title: Experience-Handoff RL：面向递归自我改进的经验交接
items.desc: 利用环境细粒度信息（如错误日志）构造可交接的经验产物，而非仅用标量奖励。
items.value: Agent RL 训练中提升样本效率的新思路。

items.title: JustRUA：GPT-6 机器人使用 Agent 的受控研究
items.desc: 拆解 harness、动作接口、经验复用与场景几何四类设计，在同一框架下对比。
items.value: 厘清机器人 Agent 涨分到底来自哪个设计选择，避免无效堆叠。

items.title: ArchSpace：LLM 架构研究的记录与引用平台
items.desc: 针对业界（DeepSeek、Qwen、Kimi）架构创新少有公开成败记录、学界评估受算力限制的问题。
items.value: 为架构决策提供可追溯的公共知识库，减少重复踩坑。

items.title: llama.cpp 发布 v1.0.0
items.desc: 本地推理生态迎来里程碑版本，Hugging Face 同步推出基于 llama.cpp 的 Llama 桌面应用，降低本地 AI 使用门槛。
items.value: 本地部署的稳定性与生态兼容性大幅提升，下游应用可放心锁定该版本。

items.title: Google 开源 TPU Sync
items.desc: C++ 库，可在 TPU HBM、主机 DRAM、存储与网络间搬运 KV cache 与权重，235B–480B MoE 模型 KV 传输延迟降低 90% 以上。
items.value: TPU 上长上下文与多轮推理的服务成本有望显著下降。

items.title: Perplexity 发布 Decider v1.3 与 Flash v1.3 开放权重决策模型
items.desc: 返回概率而非文本，新增 Locate 做片段抽取，63 项查询分类任务平均准确率 91.6%。
items.value: 路由、分类、抽取类任务可用小决策模型替代大 LLM，降本明显。

items.title: AWS 发布 AWS Emulator
items.desc: CC0 许可的本地 AWS API 模拟器，覆盖 200+ 服务，由自主 Agent 编写全部代码，发布时通过 42,857 项保真测试的 56.6%。
items.value: 本地开发与 CI 可脱离真实云环境，但保真度仍需按服务甄别。

items.title: 阿里开源 open-code-review
items.desc: 确定性流水线 + LLM Agent 的混合架构代码审查工具，支持行级评论与 NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL 注入等规则集。
items.value: 大厂规模验证过的代码审查 Agent 可直接接入现有 CI。

items.title: Chrome DevTools MCP
items.desc: 官方为编码 Agent 提供 Chrome DevTools 能力。
items.value: 前端 Agent 可获得真实浏览器调试上下文，减少盲改。

items.title: “No AI Slop”宣言在 HN 引发争论
items.desc: 一份反对 AI 生成低质内容泛滥的宣言登上 Hacker News 首页，获 180 分、99 条评论，社区围绕“如何界定 slop”与“工具无罪还是产出有罪”激烈交锋。
items.value: 产品侧需正视用户对 AI 生成内容的疲劳，透明度与人工把关成为差异化点。

items.title: 英伟达员工请愿“Bring Back THE Boss”
items.desc: r/LocalLLaMA 热议英伟达员工联名请愿黄仁勋回归，被比作“第二个 Sam Altman 时刻”；同时社区讨论 A100 二手价已再跌 20–30%，认为其已无法用于推理、只剩价格敏感的小型买家接盘。
items.value: 二手算力市场价格信号明确，小团队采购旧卡需谨慎评估残值与能效。

en.headline: Nvidia leadership change: Jensen Huang's resignation triggers chain reaction
headline_alt: Huang's departure shakes AI venture capital
The end of the founder era and a revaluation of compute capital
en.observation: Jensen Huang's resignation is the gravitational center of all today's news, but what truly warrants alarm is not the personnel change but the financial guarantee model the WSJ disclosed—NVIDIA used off-balance-sheet commitments to prop up the purchasing power of downstream cloud providers and OpenAI, and once this leverage contracts, the shock will travel along the financing chain to every AI startup. By contrast, Anthropic's IPO being 6x oversubscribed and LangChain's $3 billion valuation show capital has not left the field but is re-picking targets with higher certainty. On the technical side, Gemini 4 Hydrogen's low-cost long context, TPU Sync's KV transfer optimization, and Perplexity's small decision model all point the same way: Agent competition is shifting from "can it be done" to "how cheap per token." And ChatGPT Wallet and Claude for Manufacturing show the Agent business loop has begun touching money and factories—in both places, compliance and approval design will become the bottleneck sooner than model capability.

items.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as NVIDIA CEO, Market Cap Wipes Out Over $3 Trillion
items.desc: NVIDIA changes leadership for the first time in 33 years as Jensen Huang resigns over an extramarital affair with a person suspected of being a Chinese spy; former CFO Colette Kress takes over as interim CEO.
items.value: The top AI compute supplier enters uncertainty; GPU-dependent teams must reassess supply chains and funding.

items.title: Huang's Departure May Be Tied to NVIDIA's High-Risk Business Practices
items.desc: WSJ reports NVIDIA provided billions in financial guarantees for cloud providers' chip purchases (including a $250 billion plan with OpenAI); Kress tried to curb risk but Huang opposed.
items.value: Exposes NVIDIA's off-balance-sheet risk, suggesting the resignation isn't just personal.

items.title: VC Circle Warns: Huang's Departure Will Hit AI Startup Funding
items.desc: VCs and founders say NVIDIA had invested tens of billions in AI startups; without Huang, funding amounts and valuations will contract.
items.value: AI startups must plan cash flow early; those reliant on NVIDIA-linked capital face highest risk.

items.title: Study Claims Six Leading Chinese Models Used Export-Controlled Blackwell Chips
items.desc: Former OpenAI researcher Will DePue, by reading chip fingerprints in model weights, says DeepSeek, Moonshot, MiniMax, Ant Group and others trained on hardware costing over $500 million.
items.value: Export control enforcement may tighten; Chinese teams' compute access faces stricter scrutiny.

items.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Wallet, Agents Can Place and Pay for Orders
items.desc: Limited rollout to US Pro subscribers first; users bind a card once, each purchase requires Face ID or fingerprint confirmation, card number hidden via payment token.
items.value: Agent commerce closes the payment loop for the first time; e-commerce and payment integration will be rewritten.

items.title: Anthropic IPO 6x Oversubscribed, May Be Largest IPO Ever
items.desc: Meanwhile, due to US export controls (ITAR), underwriting banks rejected subscription orders from mainland China and Hong Kong investors.
items.value: AI leaders' capitalization accelerates, but geopolitics is directly cutting off investment access.

items.title: OpenAI Disbands Robotics Team, General Models Can Now Directly Drive Robots
items.desc: The robotics team is dissolved as the company pivots to general models directly controlling hardware.
items.value: Robotics startups' differentiation narrows; general model vendors become upstream competitors.

items.title: Anthropic Releases Claude for Manufacturing
items.desc: Plugins connect directly to Autodesk Fusion, Oracle NetSuite, Infor; 17 skills can draft quotes, compare prices, and reorder on delays, all requiring human approval; a Model Hardware Standard is also in development.
items.value: A landing template for agents in industrial software; manufacturers can reference its approval-based design.

items.title: LangChain Valued at $3 Billion
items.desc: Its model- and platform-agnostic agent management tool LangSmith already has 7,000 customers.
items.value: The agent observability and orchestration layer is confirmed by capital as an independent category.

items.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen
items.desc: A high-speed model for agent scenarios, 1M token window, 4 thinking depth levels, priced at $1.50/$7.50, Artificial Analysis score 51, Terminal-Bench 4.1 at 57%, 2.5x faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash, already integrated into Search and Gemini App.
items.value: A strong low-cost long-context agent option; note Gemini 4 series prices rise from December.

items.title: Meta Muse Can Call US Businesses on Users' Behalf
items.desc: Available with paid subscription; AI chief Alexandr Wang says Muse has over 10 million users; but many businesses hang up once they detect AI.
items.value: Voice agents hit real resistance; merchant-side AI detection and blocking will become a new need.

items.title: OpenAI Enters Cybersecurity Market with Daybreak Brand
items.desc: Launches two security products.
items.value: Security vendors must assess direct competition with foundation model vendors.

items.title: EgoX: A Cross-Embodiment Egocentric Manipulation Learning Framework
items.desc: Organizes heterogeneous demonstrations from humans, real robots, and simulation via semantically aligned observation and action modalities, pretraining a modular cross-embodiment Transformer.
items.value: Offers robot policies a unified path to leverage multi-source data, reducing reliance on single real-robot data.

items.title: PixVid: Lifting Latent Video Diffusion Models to Pixel Space
items.desc: Bypasses the resolution, per-frame conditioning, and interaction limits imposed by VAE spatiotemporal compression.
items.value: A key step toward high-resolution, interactive video generation, directly affecting video model architecture choices.

items.title: Zero or T Thinking: Hybrid Decision Models Learn When to Reason
items.desc: A single model either answers directly in one forward pass (generating 0 tokens) or performs full autoregressive reasoning when worthwhile.
items.value: Provides inference-cost-adaptive solutions for decision models, directly valuable for Agent latency and cost optimization.

items.title: Experience-Handoff RL: Experience Handoff for Recursive Self-Improvement
items.desc: Uses fine-grained environment information (e.g., error logs) to construct handoff-able experience artifacts rather than relying only on scalar rewards.
items.value: A new idea for improving sample efficiency in Agent RL training.

items.title: JustRUA: A Controlled Study of GPT-6 Robot-Using Agents
items.desc: Decomposes four design categories—harness, action interface, experience reuse, and scene geometry—and compares them under the same framework.
items.value: Clarifies which design choices actually drive robot Agent gains, avoiding ineffective stacking.

items.title: ArchSpace: A Recording and Citation Platform for LLM Architecture Research
items.desc: Addresses the lack of public success/failure records for industry architecture innovations (DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi) and the compute constraints on academic evaluation.
items.value: Provides a traceable public knowledge base for architecture decisions, reducing repeated pitfalls.

items.title: llama.cpp releases v1.0.0
items.desc: A milestone release for the local inference ecosystem; Hugging Face simultaneously launches a Llama desktop app built on llama.cpp, lowering the barrier to local AI use.
items.value: Local deployment stability and ecosystem compatibility improve greatly, so downstream apps can safely pin this version.

items.title: Google open-sources TPU Sync
items.desc: A C++ library that moves KV cache and weights among TPU HBM, host DRAM, storage, and network, cutting KV transfer latency for 235B–480B MoE models by over 90%.
items.value: Serving costs for long-context and multi-turn inference on TPUs should drop significantly.

items.title: Perplexity releases Decider v1.3 and Flash v1.3 open-weight decision models
items.desc: They return probabilities instead of text, add Locate for span extraction, and average 91.6% accuracy across 63 query classification tasks.
items.value: Small decision models can replace large LLMs for routing, classification, and extraction, cutting costs clearly.

items.title: AWS releases AWS Emulator
items.desc: A CC0-licensed local AWS API emulator covering 200+ services, with all code written by autonomous agents; at release it passed 56.6% of 42,857 fidelity tests.
items.value: Local dev and CI can run without a real cloud, but fidelity must be checked per service.

items.title: Alibaba open-sources open-code-review
items.desc: A hybrid code review tool combining a deterministic pipeline with LLM agents, supporting line-level comments and rule sets for NPE, thread safety, XSS, SQL injection, and more.
items.value: A code review agent validated at big-company scale can plug directly into existing CI.

items.title: Chrome DevTools MCP
items.desc: An official project giving coding agents Chrome DevTools capabilities.
items.value: Frontend agents gain real browser debugging context, reducing blind edits.

items.title: The "No AI Slop" manifesto sparks debate on HN
items.desc: A manifesto against the flood of low-quality AI-generated content hit the Hacker News front page with 180 points and 99 comments, as the community clashed over "how to define slop" and "are the tools innocent or is the output guilty."
items.value: Product teams must confront user fatigue with AI content; transparency and human review become differentiators.

items.title: NVIDIA employees petition to "Bring Back THE Boss"
items.desc: r/LocalLLaMA is buzzing over NVIDIA employees' joint petition for Jensen Huang's return, likened to "a second Sam Altman moment"; meanwhile the community notes used A100 prices have fallen another 20–30%, arguing they can no longer be used for inference and only price-sensitive small buyers are left to take them.
items.value: Used compute prices send a clear signal; small teams buying old cards must weigh resale value and efficiency.
